newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: IMF says Moldova economy unsatisfactory.
newsitem.headline: IMF says Moldova economy unsatisfactory.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund said on Wednesday that Moldova's economic performance was not fully satisfactory, and a $195 million three-year loan programme would remain suspended if there was no improvement.

The IMF hopes to resume disbursals of the Extended Fund Facility later this year, after suspending them in the second half of 1996, IMF representative Mark Horton said in advance of an IMF mission visiting Moldova next week.
"But that is not a sure thing. Implementation of the agreed package of measures is relatively positive, but the mission and the IMF Board have to make the final decision", Horton told Reuters.
